Estimated trend from %1$s: %2$s. Current: %3$s. Tap the chart to inspect a point.

Past points use each currency’s reconstructed day-end balance and current exchange rates. Securities and unlinked brokerage contributions stay at their current valuation, so this is not a history of market prices.

Archived accounts are included. Edited or deleted entries and changes to account type can change the reconstructed past. Balances before an opening or calibration are worked back from later records rather than set to zero.

The dotted final segment leads to Current, the same native net-worth total shown on Home. It may include future-dated entries and anchors; it is not today’s closing balance. Longer ranges sample real day-end values across the full period without averaging them.
